text:
alex: Quick update — canary for hot-path kernel remap + dynamic token-splitting just landed on a small fleet. Early aggregate: p50 -18%, p99 -12%, token cost -22% on our production-like mix. Rolling out benchmarks now. :tada:

morgan: nice!! can you paste the bench command and the baseline numbers?

alex: sure — command used: `./rbench --suite=rt_hotpath --seq-dist=prod --warmup=2m --iter=5000`

alex: raw snippet from bench run:
```
baseline: p50=62ms p95=140ms p99=220ms cost=1.00x
hotpath-remap+split: p50=51ms p95=130ms p99=194ms cost=0.78x
delta: p50=-18% p99=-12% cost=-22%
```

tara: any error/regression signals? memory/power impact?

alex: no regressions in 10k requests smoke. memory +2% peak on a few kernels, but within headroom. power flattening slightly due to fewer stalls.

sam: what's the failure/fallback behavior if new kernel misbehaves?

alex: we added a lightweight health probe: if tail latency increases >5% over a 5m window we flip to `generic-kernel` for affected frontier. automatic rollback onboarded.

deploy-bot: canary started by alex at 1998642000, target hosts=24, traffic=3% -> monitoring channel: #runtime-canaries

morgan: any model-specific variance? e.g., short chat vs long instruction loops?

alex: short sequences see bigger p50 wins (20-25%). long sequences see modest cost wins ~10-15% because split reduces KV cache thrash on heavy-attn layers.

tara: do we need config changes for Dedicated customers?

alex: no config changes required; falls under runtime default kernel-selection. But we'll add an opt-out flag in Dedicated UI for 1.0 release.

sam: propose ramp plan: 3% -> 10% (24h) -> 30% (48h) -> 100% with health gates. also enable extra logging for first 48h at 10% for easier triage.

alex: agreed. I'll open the rollout ticket and attach perf dumps. link: <https://internal.redwood/bench/1998642000-hotpath>

morgan: awesome work team. can we get a short blurb for Monday all-hands? 1 slide + 1 sentence. :clap:

alex: will do.

deploy-bot: canary health OK at 1998642080 (p50 delta -17%, p99 delta -10%).

tara: tagging infra to watch for perf counters: @infra-team

alex: thanks everyone — will post full canary report once we finish 24h. If you see anything odd ping me or drop notes in #runtime-canaries.
